checklist_rule: Every capability ID must occur in deterministic cases where applicable and in both controlled and frozen task suites. Case authors may add stricter checks but may not delete these.

capabilities.criterion: Decompose the question into reproducible source-specific queries and eligibility criteria.
Use complementary source families and disclose coverage limitations.
Preserve stable identifiers, provenance, and identifier-first deduplication.
Account for screening, exclusions, citation expansion, contradictions, and stopping evidence.
Produce a traceable search map suitable for access, synthesis, and monitoring.
Resolve the exact work, version, supplement, correction, and retraction family.
Rank OA, official API, licensed ZJU, and manual routes without overstating entitlement.
Record obtained and missing components with stable identity and access status.
Return an executable manual or library path after automation failure.
Reject credential persistence, paywall bypass, and prohibited bulk retrieval while preserving a useful path.
Compare DOI, authors, title, dates, venue, volume, issue, and pages field by field.
Detect correction, retraction, expression-of-concern, and version relationships with dated evidence.
Judge the exact cited claim separately from bibliographic identity and within study-design limits.
Preserve source conflicts and unassessable claims without guessing.
Return usable citation and Zotero corrections with human-confirmation boundaries.
Cover the full available document and anchor claims to pages, sections, and objects.
Interpret equations, figures, tables, supplements, and extraction gaps without invention.
Reconstruct question, design, evidence, warrant, alternatives, and boundary conditions.
Separate author claims, reported observations, and reader interpretation.
Emit source-bound paper-spine records for synthesis and hypothesis work.
Capture text, image, audio/transcript, instrument, and file facts without changing originals.
Produce parseable YAML/Markdown with required experiment fields and explicit unknowns.
Preserve experimental units, replicates, hierarchy, outcomes, exclusions, and analysis status.
Link raw and derived artifacts by paths, hashes, roles, and derivation.
Represent corrections and retrospective reconstruction without overwriting or backdating observations.
Identify the estimand, experimental unit, dependence, analysis population, and design defects.
Execute supported methods faithfully and reject unsupported design simplifications.
Report effect sizes, intervals, exact sample accounting, diagnostics, and sensitivity.
Handle families, missingness, exclusions, and analysis changes transparently.
Bind canonical result IDs across manuscript, figure, table, supplement, and response.
Distinguish draft, revise, and polish behavior and preserve the requested scope.
Bind every material claim to author data, methods, or verified literature.
Preserve numbers, direction, significance, units, terminology, and citation scope.
Build a coherent question-to-evidence argument with bounded interpretation and limitations.
Keep claims and result IDs aligned across all manuscript surfaces.
Version the monitoring question, source queries, cadence, and watch targets.
Distinguish new, updated, duplicate, unresolved, corrected, and retracted records.
Preserve source-specific counts, failures, screening, and query drift without false zeros.
Prioritize records by their effect on claims, gaps, hypotheses, data, and code.
Keep archive and notification actions explicit, authorized, bounded, and resumable.
Choose and freeze an appropriate synthesis mode, eligibility frame, and deviations.
Extract anchored study-outcome-timepoint records without double counting studies.
Assess design-appropriate bias, directness, and applicability with explicit unknowns.
Gate pooling and distinguish direction conflict, heterogeneity, and evidence-strength imbalance.
Grade certainty by outcome and preserve claim, gap, and study IDs downstream.
Separate observations, verified evidence, assumptions, and speculation.
Generate materially different alternatives including null or artifact explanations.
Give prospective outcome signatures, boundaries, and falsifiers for each hypothesis.
Map causal structure, confounding, controls, and experimental units.
Rank staged experiments by discrimination and write pre-result decision and stop rules.
Bind panel claims, variables, units, experimental units, and result IDs to source artifacts.
Choose marks that represent design, dependence, uncertainty, and sample structure correctly.
Record transformations and image adjustments without altering scientific content.
Generate editable source and correct requested vector/raster artifacts.
Inspect target-size rendering, accessibility, legend completeness, and data-to-mark consistency.
Build a time-bounded audience-appropriate narrative from the paper's evidence.
Anchor every slide claim, number, visual, and equation to the source.
Maintain terminology, equation explanation, timing, and speaker-note support.
Create an actual inspectable PPTX when requested and distinguish plan from generated artifact.
Render and inspect every slide for clipping, fonts, glyphs, resolution, and readability.
Reconstruct central claims, contribution, evidence chain, and assessment boundary.
Evaluate scientific validity, statistics, reproducibility, reporting, and domain objections.
Give stable, evidence-anchored concerns with consequence and feasible resolution tests.
Separate blocking, major, minor, and not-assessable items without a concern quota.
Preserve reviewer isolation and disclose when independent panel conditions are unavailable.
Preserve verbatim editor/reviewer items, boundaries, stable IDs, owners, and status.
Never describe planned or unverified work as completed.
Link each response to evidence, result IDs, exact manuscript changes, and locations.
Handle disagreement respectfully with evidence, clarification, and bounded alternatives.
Keep reviewer-separated letters, manuscript, redline, figures, supplement, and numbers aligned.
Map every claim-supporting data, code, material, and environment artifact by stable ID.
Represent public, controlled, embargoed, third-party, and unavailable routes truthfully.
Verify repositories, versions, identifiers, licenses, metadata, and citation details.
Specify inputs, environment, entrypoint, seeds, expected outputs, lineage, and verification.
Keep the polished statement consistent with the inventory and unresolved owner decisions.
Extract and enforce the supplied current call, limits, criteria, eligibility, and attachments.
Separate verified evidence, preliminary facts, resources, assumptions, and unresolved claims.
Connect bounded gaps and competing hypotheses to measurable objectives and contributions.
Create dependency-aware work packages with units, outputs, milestones, and success/inconclusive/failure branches.
Align evidence, resources, schedule, budget, ethics, data, risk, and reproducibility without invention.
Preserve confidentiality and exact disclosure facts before drafting.
Bind every feature, number, condition, effect, and alternative to exact source anchors and support states.
Build problem-solution-effect, feature-evidence, dependency, and embodiment maps without unsupported broadening.
Separate query plans, search hits, verified facts, and professional legal conclusions.
Avoid inventorship and patentability conclusions and prepare a usable professional handoff.
Resolve parent, salt, stereochemistry, isotope, charge, tautomer, and identifier provenance.
Choose appropriate public and licensed databases by evidence need and query mode.
Keep experimental, curated, computed, predicted, vendor, and regulatory evidence distinct.
Compare properties, bioactivity, reactions, or spectra only under compatible identities and conditions.
Preserve provenance, uncertainty, access limits, and unresolved database conflicts.
Preserve originals, versions, hashes, approvals, environments, and communication boundaries.
Map claims to data, code, images, statistics, citations, approvals, and contributors.
Separate facts, anomalies, missing documentation, interpretations, and allegations.
Assess integrity domains and severity without automated guilt or intent findings.
Recommend proportionate remediation, owners, holds, disclosure, and current authorized escalation routes.
Create, validate, resume, and audit versioned mission state without erasing failures or unknowns.
Select the smallest correct specialist DAG with prerequisites, outputs, gates, and stop conditions.
Bind real artifacts, validators, hashes, attestations, and human decisions before advancing status.
Resolve available host providers explicitly and preserve unresolved execution requirements.
Maintain evidence/result/artifact identity and release gates across an end-to-end research mission.
